messages.subject: For Wendell Weeks | Advanced materials, infrastructure and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Corning Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Wendell P. Weeks, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President.

Corning's global role across advanced materials, optical communications and industrial technology increasingly intersects with governments, infrastructure investment, sustainability priorities and strategic customers. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder execution might support Corning's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Corning Incorporated.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
